corrective_notes_to_bound_matrix: MR-Coupler's 50 historical defects were selected from defects already detected by human-written metamorphic test cases; they are not an unselected historical-fault sample.
Task Verification Bench is the closest evidence-unit prior because it uses original task artifacts and update-derived root-cause ground truth.

The combination of Task Verification Bench, BenchGuard or ABA, Judge Reliability Harness or evaluator blind-spot perturbations, MR-Coupler or MeMo, and test-provenance controls absorbs the broad formulation even though no single paper matches all five axes.

five_axis_verdict.research_object: directly overlapped by benchmark-defect and evaluator-reliability studies
five_axis_verdict.core_question: directly overlapped by defect-detection and root-cause-recall studies
five_axis_verdict.intervention_or_method: composition of established structured audit, contract extraction, property-based testing, and metamorphic testing
five_axis_verdict.evaluation_unit_and_evidence: partly distinct only if pre-fix-blinded executable parent-fail/fix-pass replay is preserved
five_axis_verdict.claim_scope: too broad unless restricted to a held-out cross-repository empirical comparison

strongest_reviewer_absorption_objection: The proposed study combines an update-derived benchmark-defect corpus, structured benchmark auditing, evaluator perturbation testing, contract-derived metamorphic testing, and executable bug reproduction. Each component and the necessary leakage and budget controls already have direct precedents. Without a fully blinded, unselected, cross-repository historical frame and valid negative controls, the work is a domain application rather than a new scientific result.
residual_question_if_reopened: Under pre-fix blinding and equal information, reasoning, tool, retry, and execution budgets, do contract-derived executable metamorphic relations improve root-cause-matched historical agent-evaluator fault recall over prior-work-anchored auditing, non-contract metamorphic testing, and general test generation on an unselected cross-repository frame with intentional-change controls?
reopen_requirements: A fully isolated pre-fix packet for every candidate
An unselected historical-fault frame with source-level ground truth
Global root-cause deduplication after eligibility adjudication
Valid normal, unrelated-change, and intentional-contract-change controls
Equal information, model, tool, retry, and execution budgets
